research_direction: #304 predicted from the 4/6/8% ladder that combining the strongest midtrain arm with planted SFT rows would land below the midtrain arm alone. This trains the missing cell (12% corpus -> planted rows) and tests it. It also states the pattern as a law: what the SFT stage adds over midtrain-only falls monotonically with midtrain dose, from +0.568 at 4% to -0.146 at 12%.
